summary.text: Heather Raymond is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 5, where she assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A clinical social worker, she is also a member of the Nashua Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Heather Raymond earned a B.S. in psychology from Worcester State University in 2004.
Her career experience includes working as a child and family social worker.
Raymond is a member of the Nashua Board of Education at-large and has served as its president.
Her 2023-2024 committee assignment in the House was the Children and Family Law Committee.
